confirmed_issues.title: Scoring editor loses the prediction quantity and canonical unit
confirmed_issues.mechanism: Score it captures only prediction ID, vehicle ID and a numeric draft at281-285. The mounted outcome form804-846 identifies vehicle but not model, target, prediction ID, forecast/reference or SI unit. Observed value819-830 has no unit hint/suffix; different range_m, soc_pct, cost_minor and energy_wh outcomes use the identical field.
confirmed_issues.source_repro: Source trace: select an unscored energy_wh or cost_minor row, then inspect the outcome form. It cannot tell a user whether 10 means Wh, metres, percent or minor units. Switch selected vehicle away and back: only the captured vehicle is explained, not the original prediction quantity. No scoring action performed.
confirmed_issues.fix: Capture an immutable scoring context and render its model/target/prediction identity, raw SI unit and reference alongside the observation input. Do not convert the submitted raw value or guess currency.
confirmed_issues.dedup: New bounded source finding; no source repair attempted.

confirmed_issues.title: Ledger does not expose stored row provenance or signed raw error
